text: FUCK! The table is uneven, so it wobbles.
So I nail the whole table to the ground. Genius.
Wait... now my floor keeps fucking wobbling. Fuck.
So I reinforce the floor into the rest of the house...
What the fuck, now my whole house is wobbling! Fucking... awesome.
Meanwhile, my cat is fucking not impressed. Not impressed at all.
So I bolt my whole house to the fucking earth.
Now the whole fucking planet is shaking!
And my cat is looking at me with a pissed off expression.
So I bolt the planet to the sun... and the sun to the fucking galaxy. Now the whole universe wobbles... so technically, the table doesn't.
The cat took the table in the divorce... fucking sweet.
